title: T-plural form review
focus: Mix regular and KPT noun plurals after both have been learned.

exercises.prompt: tuoli (“chair”) → ____ (“chairs”)
exercises.explanation: tuoli means “chair”; tuolit means “chairs”. The nominative T-plural is formed here by adding -t: tuoli → tuolit.
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Regular T-plural: form not yet correct

answerDiagnostics.explanation: In this taught T-plural, keep tuoli unchanged and add -t: tuolit.

exercises.prompt: cats — use the supplied base kissa (“cat”)
exercises.explanation: kissa means “cat”; kissat means “cats”. The nominative T-plural is formed here by adding -t: kissa → kissat.
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Regular T-plural: form not yet correct

answerDiagnostics.explanation: Use plural -t: kissa + t = kissat. Kissa is singular and kissan is genitive.

exercises.prompt: kuva (“picture”) → ____ (“pictures”)
exercises.explanation: kuva means “picture”; kuvat means “pictures”. The nominative T-plural is formed here by adding -t: kuva → kuvat.
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Regular T-plural: form not yet correct

answerDiagnostics.explanation: Keep kuva unchanged and add -t directly: kuvat. Do not insert e.

exercises.prompt: pelto (“field”) → ____ (“fields”)
exercises.explanation: pelto means “field”; pellot means “fields”. Add plural -t to the weak stem. The KPT change is lt → ll: pelto → pellot.
exercises.misconceptionCategory: T-plural with KPT: form not yet correct

answerDiagnostics.category: T-plural with KPT: strong grade retained
answerDiagnostics.explanation: Before plural -t, change lt to ll: pello- + t = pellot.

exercises.prompt: combs — use the supplied base kampa (“comb”)
exercises.explanation: kampa means “comb”; kammat means “combs”. Add plural -t to the weak stem. The KPT change is mp → mm: kampa → kammat.
exercises.misconceptionCategory: T-plural with KPT: form not yet correct

answerDiagnostics.category: T-plural with KPT: strong grade retained
answerDiagnostics.explanation: Before plural -t, change mp to mm: kamma- + t = kammat.

exercises.prompt: Choose the form meaning “beaches” from ranta (“beach”).
exercises.explanation: ranta means “beach”; rannat means “beaches”. Add plural -t to the weak stem. The KPT change is nt → nn: ranta → rannat.

optionFeedback.rannat: Correct. ranta means “beach”; rannat means “beaches”. Add plural -t to the weak stem. The KPT change is nt → nn: ranta → rannat.
optionFeedback.rantat: The plural ending -t is present, but the strong cluster nt must weaken to nn: ranta → rannat.
optionFeedback.ranta: Ranta is the singular form “beach”. The plural needs both the weak stem ranna- and plural -t: rannat.
